network_identity.network_identity_caveat: Native main/test genesis and P2P magic coincide; mainnet canonical replay and authority configuration are required.

activation_requirements: production IPotcoinFinalityVerifier420 validates canonical PotCoin mainnet header/stake chain
only post-bootstrap proof-of-stake blocks above height 500 are accepted
transaction inclusion is proven against a finalized canonical PotCoin block
gateway output script is governance allowlisted
source UTXO provenance and output identity are proven
POT asset id and route id are governance bound
route risk caps and emergency isolation are configured
end-to-end native POT inbound and outbound qualification passes
security_invariants: source-output replay under a different message id fails closed
direct adapter calls bypassing GatewayRouter420 fail closed
outbound destinations are constrained to native PotCoin P2PKH/P2SH hash160 payloads

verifier.trust_model: Explicit authenticated full-native replay checkpoint; X13, UTXO state, modifier ancestry, scripts/rewards and greatest-chain-trust canonicality depend on native replay authority. Not a permissionless light client or irreversible PoS finality.
